name: County Budget
blurb: Where the money comes from and where it goes — 8 years, traced to the record.

name: Budget vs. Actual
blurb: What was budgeted vs. what was actually spent, by category, every year.

name: Spending Detail
blurb: Drill the General Fund down to individual line items, year by year.

name: Meeting Records & Minutes
blurb: Every Fiscal Court meeting's official minutes, linked straight to the county's records.

name: DLG Reports & Audits
blurb: The county's own state filings and independent audits, linked at the source.

name: Debt & Obligations
blurb: What the county owes, for what, and when it's paid off — from the audited financial notes.

name: Ordinances & Resolutions
blurb: What the Fiscal Court has formally enacted — linked to the county's ordinance records.

name: County Checkbook
blurb: Every vendor payment — check, claim, department, amount. Needs the county claims register (open records).

name: Vendor Spending
blurb: Top vendors and multi-year totals, built from the claims register once obtained.

name: Vote Tracker
blurb: Every motion in one searchable place — who moved it, who seconded, the result, and the roll-call detail on split votes.

name: Grants & Outside Funding
blurb: Outside funding the county pursued and won — bridges, broadband, FEMA, economic development — from the public record. Spend-by-grant reconciliation still needs the claims register.

name: Capital Projects
blurb: Roads, buildings, equipment by district — budget, status, and outcome.

name: Open Records Log
blurb: Requests received and turnaround time — published by the county, privacy-protected.
